name: Number Base Converter
summary: Convert numbers between binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal — locally in your browser.
description: Type a value in any base (2, 8, 10, or 16) and see the others update instantly. Supports optional 0b / 0o / 0x prefixes, negatives, and large integers via BigInt.

faqs.question: Can I use prefixes?
faqs.answer: Yes. 0b for binary, 0o for octal, and 0x for hex are optional and stripped when parsing.

faqs.question: Is there a size limit?
faqs.answer: Values use JavaScript BigInt, so very large integers work as long as your browser can handle them.
